name: The Gate Remembers You / The Cage Knows Your Name

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Range 60 feet

Saving Throw Will

Once per day, a powerful reputation-based effect triggers off what you're now known for.

Invoke what you are known for. Every creature within range that has heard of you attempts a Will save against your spell DC. Allies and those who revere what you did gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, saves and skill checks for 1 minute. Those who fear it and fail are frightened 2 and cannot willingly approach you for 1 minute. A creature that has never heard of you is unaffected — that is the cost of a reputation-based effect.
